features: ✅ 360° Panoramic Pan & Tilt Security Coverage – This smart bulb CCTV camera provides full 360-degree horizontal and vertical rotation, allowing you to monitor every corner of your room. Control the camera movement remotely through the mobile app for complete indoor surveillance without blind spots.

✅ Two-Way Audio Communication System – Features an integrated microphone and speaker that allow you to listen and speak through the camera using the mobile app. Ideal for communicating with family members, kids, elderly people, or even warning intruders.

✅ Wireless WiFi Connectivity for Mobile App – Supports stable wireless WiFi connection, allowing remote monitoring, live playback, and control from anywhere using your smartphone. No messy cables required.
✅ Smart Mobile App Control – The dedicated app allows you to manage live viewing, camera rotation, playback, motion alerts, and audio settings easily from one place.
✅ Multi-Purpose Indoor Surveillance Camera – Perfect for home security, baby monitoring, nanny supervision, elderly care, office monitoring, shop security, and small business surveillance.
✅ Easy Bulb Socket Installation – Just screw into a standard B22 bulb holder; no wiring or drilling required for quick setup.
